question: Should `openclawProgressKind="tool-progress"` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a supported public plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but exposing a new generic payload classification to third-party plugins is a permanent API direction choice whose relationship to broader status notices needs owner intent.

options.title: Approve narrow progress
options.body: Keep the distinct public kind and predicate, with focused tests defining their narrower semantics relative to status notices.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Move the progress intent behind a bundled runtime seam while retaining the Slack suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow progress
recommendation.body: Keep the distinct public kind and predicate, with focused tests defining their narrower semantics relative to status notices.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this contributor to both overlapping reply-payload semantics and the current Slack send surface.
